title: SAS Superstation Capability Descriptor
description: What a pod declares it can do. See SPEC.md §7.

version.description: Semver of the PAYLOAD contract. Independent of the kernel version.

degradesTo.description: Capability to fall back to when this one cannot be resolved.

requires.description: Capabilities that must themselves resolve for this one to be usable.

privileged.description: Declares that this capability mutates state or exposes secrets. Declaration only - enforcement stays with each platform's auth layer (SPEC.md §9).

capabilityId.description: Dotted lowercase capability ID, e.g. sas.telemetry.thermal. Prefixes are meaningful for subscription.
